poem.title: Mithridates
poem.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
poem.text:
I cannot spare water or wine,
Tobacco-leaf, or poppy, or rose;
From the earth-poles to the Line,
All between that works or grows,
Every thing is kin of mine.

Give me agates for my meat,
Give me cantharids to eat,
From air and ocean bring me foods,
From all zones and altitudes.

From all natures, sharp and slimy,
Salt and basalt, wild and tame,
Tree, and lichen, ape, sea-lion,
Bird and reptile be my game.

Ivy for my fillet band,
Blinding dogwood in my hand,
Hemlock for my sherbet cull me,
And the prussic juice to lull me,
Swing me in the upas boughs,
Vampire-fanned, when I carouse.

Too long shut in strait and few,
Thinly dieted on dew,
I will use the world, and sift it,
To a thousand humors shift it,
As you spin a cherry.
O doleful ghosts, and goblins merry,
O all you virtues, methods, mights;
Means, appliances, delights;
Reputed wrongs, and braggart rights;
Smug routine, and things allowed;
Minorities, things under cloud!
Hither! take me, use me, fill me,
Vein and artery, though ye kill me;
God! I will not be an owl,
But sun me in the Capitol.

listen.why: Gesang der Jünglinge is an electronic music work by Karlheinz Stockhausen. It was realized in 1955–56 at the Westdeutscher Rundfunk studio in Cologne and is Work Number 8 in the composer's catalog. The vocal parts were supplied by 12-year-old Josef Protschka.

crossover.title: Architectural acoustics
crossover.body: Architectural acoustics is the science and engineering of achieving a good sound within a building and is a branch of acoustical engineering. The first application of modern scientific methods to architectural acoustics was carried out by the American physicist Wallace Sabine in the Fogg Museum lecture room. He applied his newfound knowledge to the design of Symphony Hall, Boston.

items.title: Physicists defy expectations by controlling the magnetic heart of a single atom
items.take: Scientists have unexpectedly discovered how to control the magnetic spin inside a single atom's nucleus using radio waves, overturning previous assumptions about atomic behavior.

items.title: GullDSP Phathom is a FREE bass preamp and distortion plugin for Windows
items.take: GullDSP offers Phathom, a free and open-source bass guitar preamp plugin for Windows, designed for fuzzy, growling, and clanky modern bass tones. We previously covered the developer’s Circulate phase smearing plugin.

items.title: Apogee Symphony I/O MK I Revived For Modern Macs By Free Open-Source Drivers
items.take: Independent developer Daniel Raffel has released free, open-source drivers and a replacement control app for Apogee’s original Symphony I/O, after Apogee gave him access to its legacy source code. Apogee’s support for the 2010 interface ended with macOS 14 Sonoma.

items.title: In Session Audio offers Dyad: Solo Kalimba FREE for Kontakt Player
items.take: In Session Audio is offering Dyad: Solo Kalimba, a kalimba sample library for the free Kontakt Player, as a free download through November 25. We’ve previously covered their Fruit Shake giveaways, which focused on sequenced shaker performances.

items.title: INSEKTIQ TONIQ Converts Audio To MIDI Inside Pro Tools Using ARA 2
items.take: INSEKTIQ has announced TONIQ, an audio-to-MIDI plugin that works directly on clips in the Pro Tools timeline through ARA 2. It converts chords, vocals, drums and full mixes to MIDI on the computer, and the free version has no length limit or watermark.

items.take: Soundtrap has added VST instrument support to its cloud-based music production platform, with Arturia’s Pigments synth and Efx MOTIONS joining the launch. The update lets producers bring virtual instruments into their Soundtrap projects alongside third-party effects.

items.title: How To Get A Professional Hearing Assessment: A Practical Guide for Audio Engineers
items.take: In our article on tinnitus, we discussed the importance of audio professionals getting regular hearing tests. In this article, we look in much greater detail at what we need from a hearing test as audio professionals and how to find and ask for the right kind of tests and care.
